pages.text:
Monthly Roadmap
Month Goal: Focus on improving foundational web skills through smaller, achievable 
daily tasks. Week 1: AWS and Git Fundamentals (daily plan): Study AWS S3, SNS, 
SFTP, VPC, VPC Endpoint, and Lambda. Day 1: Setup a VPC and create a VPC 
endpoint. Day 2: Create a SNS topic and publish a message. Day 3: Set up CloudFront 
distribution. Day 4: Configure SSL for your VPC. Day 5: Test AWS S3 and SNS 
connectivity. Day 6: Configure DNS record for your VPC endpoint. Day 7: Verify AWS 
setup is working. Week 2: HTML and CSS Fundamentals (daily plan): Practice writing 
responsive CSS with flexbox and grid layout. Day 1: Learn Flexbox and Grid for flexible 
layouts. Day 2: Write a responsive card component. Day 3: Add hover effects to card 
components. Day 4: Write a dropdown menu system. Day 5: Add a slider and animate it. 
Day 6: Combine all components into a single page. Day 7: Debug and refine the design. 
Week 3: React Performance and Optimizations (daily plan): Study how to use React 
Router and lazy loading. Day 1: Configure React Router for dynamic routes. Day 2: 
Implement lazy loading for images. Day 3: Learn useEffect for async component 
updates. Day 4: Add custom state to toggle navigation. Day 5: Implement error handling 
in React. Day 6: Test both router and lazy loading. Day 7: Refactor the route structure. 
Week 4: Express Web Frameworks and Database Operations (daily plan): Learn 
Node.js basics and install Mongoose for MongoDB. Day 1: Install mongoose package 
and run migrations. Day 2: Define models for User and Post. Day 3: Import data into the 
database. Day 4: Create CRUD endpoints for users and posts. Day 5: Query the 
database and display results. Day 6: Test API endpoints. Day 7: Document the 
database schema. Mini Project: Build a user management website with CRUD 
endpoints, styled using CSS Flexbox and grid, and using lazy loading for images.
